questions.question: Who is the author of Psalm 50?
What does God say about sacrifices and his needs?
options: The blood of bulls and goats is pleasing to his taste
He longs for the smoke of the offerings to rise
He counts each gift and rewards the one who gives most
If he were hungry he would not tell us, for the world is his
questions.answer: If he were hungry he would not tell us, for the world is his
